pages.title: 欢迎使用 PokeDaisy
pages.summary: 了解 PokeDaisy、各屏幕的内容、开始使用所需的条件，以及后续阅读资料。

c.text: PokeDaisy 是一款面向宝可梦游戏的 Android 游戏播放器，支持 Game Boy、Game Boy Color、Game Boy Advance 和 Nintendo DS。游戏旁边运行着实时
，在游玩时读取队伍、背包、当前地图、战斗状况和图鉴，还提供先显示提示、再显示答案的攻略。在 AYN Thor 等双屏掌机上，助手独占下屏；在单屏掌机上，助手以游戏上方的窗口或旁边的面板显示；手机竖屏时则显示在游戏下方。
无需暂停游戏、打开菜单，也能查看宝可梦的招式或攻击对某种属性的效果。这些信息会以游戏菜单的风格显示。

Losing a 40-hour save is the worst thing an emulator can do, so PokeDaisy is careful with it:
A backup every time you start a game.
Before the game opens its save, PokeDaisy copies it into a

Resuming never overwrites a newer save.

When a game picks up where you left off, PokeDaisy first checks the save file hasn't changed since. If it has (you played it in RetroArch, copied in another save, or moved your saves folder), the old snapshot is set aside and the game starts from the save file instead.
A save in progress always finishes.
If you leave the game while it says it's saving (HOME, the recent apps screen,

This works with any game, not only the ones the companion supports, and with Game Boy and DS games too.
To check a game before playing it, long-press it in the library and open

PokeDaisy plays in softcore, for two reasons:

RetroAchievements only accepts hardcore unlocks from emulators it has checked and approved, and that takes time for a new app. Until then, the site counts hardcore unlocks from PokeDaisy as softcore anyway.

Hardcore would have to switch off things PokeDaisy is built around: loading save states (including picking up where you left off when you open a game), rewind, and the companion's battle buttons, which press the game's buttons for you.
Your softcore achievements and points are real and show on your profile. They're listed separately from hardcore ones.

Turbo counts in game time, so with fast-forward on it mashes faster along with the game. It pauses while the companion's battle buttons are pressing the game's buttons for you.
Hotkeys are shortcuts for things outside the game: save states, fast-forward, leaving the game. A hotkey can be one button or a
